stem: Which sequence best protects identity during a cloning task?
choices: Confirm donor identity, prepare labeled receiving positions, take/process cuttings under the approved workflow, then reconcile counts and records
Take all cuttings first and label them from memory afterward
Mix donors in one tray and sort them after rooting
Remove donor labels to simplify cleaning
rationale: Identity should be controlled before and during handling, not reconstructed from memory after the fact.
